As with the similarly named Studio Delta Srl record elsewhere in this dataset, this pattern points to a small office rather than a data-center business. This entry documents the likely mistag rather than fabricating data-center specifications for what is, by its own name, a small professional-services firm.

reading.body:
Studio BETA SRLS in Porto San Giorgio, Italy, is not a data center: it is a small professional services office mistagged in OpenStreetMap, with zero megawatts of capacity.

The name carries the Italian corporate suffix SRLS, used by simplified limited-liability companies, and the word Studio, which indicates a professional practice rather than a data center operator. The record has no operator, no website, and no suitability assessment, and its listed capacity is zero megawatts.

For AI infrastructure accounting, this entry adds no compute capacity, no data center building, and no power demand. It matters only as a caution that OpenStreetMap telecom=data_center tags can capture small offices, so unfiltered counts would overstate the number of actual facilities. The data does not describe any real data center in Porto San Giorgio or nearby.
